_No response_

Home Assistant OS

Same with OneTouch modes, although those are at least in the iAquaLink app so probably exposed somehow. Freeze protection status of the pump is also exposed in the UI so may be available to this integration.

Side note: If the library raises library specific exceptions it's better to not let other exceptions out but always raise library specific exceptions.

One reason is apparent in this PR. If the library would have had library specific exceptions for the transport errors it could have changed the underlying transport without breaking the integration.

I'd recommend changing the library in this way in the future.
